propositions: Cloud and Data Center have incompatible user identity representations (opaque accountId vs name), causing leakage into assignee resolution and transport payloads

PR #120's getattr-based discovery of _assignee_resolver made the DC authoritative branch unreachable, causing permanent non-authoritative resolution and assignee-diff churn on every reconciliation pass
A UserIdentityModel Protocol with resolve() and to_payload() methods must unify the contract with two implementations: AccountIdIdentity for Cloud and NameIdentity for DC
NameIdentity must perform a real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and enable convergence, eliminating the churn defect
The identity models must receive their resolver as an explicit parameter at construction, not via getattr discovery, to eliminate unreachable branches
